lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/د/ر q–d–r power, strength, ability, to have power
; fate, to decree, to pre‐ordain; to reckon, to measure; extent, worth, sum; destruction, to strain, to straiten; cooking pot.

Of this root, 14 forms occur in 132 places in the Qur’an:
قَدَرَ qadara 23 times; قُدِرَ qudira 2 times; قَدَّرَ qaddara 16 times; قَدْر qadr 7 times; قَادِر qādir 7 times; قَادِرُون qādirūn 7 times; قَدِير qadır 45 times; تَقْدِير taqdır 5 times; مَقْدُور maqdūr 1 time; مِقْدَار miqdār 3 times; مُقْتَدِر muqtadir 3 times; مُقْتَدِرُون muqtadirūn 1 time; قَدَر qadar11 times and قُدُور qudūr 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَدِير qadır [intens. act. part.] one most able, one in absolute control

entries.label: قَدِير
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدِير qadır [intens. act. part.] one most able, one in absolute control

(22:6) وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ and He gives life to the dead; He has absolute control over everything.‏

entries.label: تَقْدِير
entries.definitionHtml:
تَقْدِير taqdır [v. n.] determining, designing

(41:12) وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذَلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ and We adorned the nearest heaven with lanterns and [also placed them there as] security (or, made them secure); such is the design of the Almighty, the All-knowing.

entries.label: قَادِر
entries.definitionHtml:
قَادِر qādir [act. part.; pl. قَادِرُون qādirūn] one who is able, or capable

(23:95) وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ to show you what We have promised them We certainly are able; *

(6:65) الْقَادِرُ [an attribute of God] the Able ‏

2 one who determines; decrees, ordains

(77:23) فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ We ordained [all that] (or, We are able) and what an excellent ordainer We are!‏‏‏

entries.label: قَدَر
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدَر qadar [n.]

1 capacity, measure

(13:17) أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا He sends from the sky water, so ravines flow, each according to its capacity ‏

2 fate, pre‐ordination, decree; predetermination, providence

(20:40) فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِى أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَى قَدَرٍ يَامُوسَى‏ so you stayed for some years among the people of Midian, then you came [here] by providence/decree, Moses

3 period, duration

(77:22) إِلَى قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ for a determined period.

entries.label: قَدَرَ(1)
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدَرَ(1) qadara i [v. intrans.]

1 to be able or have the strength or the ability to act or do something

(16:75) ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلا عَبْدًا مَمْلُوكًا لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ God coins the similitude of a slave, owned, having no control over anything

2 to overpower, to catch up with, to get the better of

(90:5) أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَنْ يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ does he think no one will be able to overpower him?

entries.label: قَدَرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدَرَ (2) qadara u/i [v. trans.]

1 to straiten, to restrict, to give in meagre quantity

(89:16) وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلاَهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ but whenever He tests him and straitens his circumstances, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me’

2 to ordain, to determine, to decree

(77:23) فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ We ordained [all that] (or, We are able) and what an excellent ordainer We are!‏‏‏

3 to reckon the worth of, to estimate the value of

(6:91) وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ إِذْ قَالُوا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَشَرٍ مِنْ شَيْءٍ and they do not measure God with His true measure when they say, ‘God has not revealed a thing to a mortal’.

entries.label: قَدَّرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدَّرَ qaddara [v. II, trans.]

1 to determine, to measure

(10:5) هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَهُ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ He it is who made the sun a shining radiance and the moon a light, and measured it in phases so that you could count the years and reckon

2 to ordain, to decree

(15:60) إِلاَّ امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind‏

3 to contemplate, to ponder, to plot

(74:18–19) أنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ he planned and plotted, confound him, how he plotted! ‏‏ ‏

entries.label: قَدْر
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدْر qadr [v. n.; n.]

1 worth, position, status, esteem

(39:67) وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ and they do not esteem God with the esteem due Him, the whole earth will be a grasp of His [in the palm of His hand] on the Day of Resurrection

2 timing; measure

(65:3) قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا God has set a due measure for everything‏; *

(97:1) لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ ‏the Night of Decree, Glory or Power, the night in which the Prophet received the revelation the first time and said to be one of the last ten nights in the month of Ramaḍān, probably the 27th; * الْقَدْرِ name of Sura 79, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

1 to the ‘Night of Decree’.

entries.label: قُدُور
entries.definitionHtml:
قُدُور qudūr [pl. of n. قِدْر qidr] cauldrons

(34:13) يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ مَحَارِيبَ وَتَمَاثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَاسِيَاتٍ they made him whatever he wanted–palaces, statues, basins as large as water troughs, and cauldrons hard to move.

entries.label: قُدِرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قُدِرَ qudira [pass. v.]

1 to be straitened, to be given in meagre quantity

(65:7) لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا ءَاتَاهُ اللَّهُ and let the affluent spend according to his wealth, but let him whose circumstances are strained spend according to what God has given him

2 to be destined, decreed; to be measured

(54:12) وَفَجَّرْنَا الأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ We split open the earth with [surging] springs–and the waters met for a decreed purpose.‏

entries.label: مَقْدُور
entries.definitionHtml:
مَقْدُور maqdūr [pass. part.] decreed, ordained, destined

(33:38) وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَقْدُورًا and the command of God is a fate ordained.

entries.label: مُقْتَدِر
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقْتَدِر muqtadir [act. part.] one most able, one in absolute control, or power

(43:42) أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُقْتَدِرُونَ or We have you witness what We promised them; We have full power over them.‏

entries.label: مِقْدَار
entries.definitionHtml:
مِقْدَار miqdār [n.] quantity, measure, extent, duration

(13:8) وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ everything with Him is in [exact] measure. ‏
